name: orders-svc
description: Frozen fixture for the bgpdd-bugfix-lane eval. The coupon field on POST /orders is optional, but src/coupons.js normalizes the code without guarding against an absent one, so POST /orders with no coupon answers 500 instead of pricing at full. The node:test suite in tests/ is green before AND after the fix: it never posts a null coupon. src/validation.js is a decoy - it is correct.
